O.outcome_detail: perceived mapping effort and workload

cells.quote: “Rough preliminary mapping” by students has proved itself: they highlighted which NKLM contents turned up in which course. That yielded a mapping plan or blueprint (see figure 2 (Fig. 2)). With these measures, the NKLM was “condensed” to the extent that lecturers no longer had to go through the entire catalogue. Focused by the blueprint, they headed directly for NKLM content and overlooked less.
cells.note: The study reports qualitative process observations rather than a quantified effect size or formal comparison.

D.comparison: mapping the NKLM without portioning into timed sections

That approach led to a temporary reduction in the quantity of data and required effort, as well as to easier planning and early, intermediate results.
